prompt: A realistic 1920s photograph on grainy colour film: real people with real skin, pores and stubble. Every moving thing leaves a trail of three or four afterimages behind it, each copy split into pure red, green and blue and fading, like a long exposure lit by repeated coloured flashes; everything still stays sharp. Camera low at the kerb. On a wet cobbled street at night under a gas lamp, a man in a red scarf and a man in a blue scarf shove each other, their swinging arms and flying hats smeared into coloured trails, the two crowds behind them waving banners; a calm gangster in a chalk-stripe suit with a scarred lip strolls past them with a canvas sack over his shoulder, perfectly sharp, with no trail at all. A police car's lamp flaring at the end of the street. Plain margins with no writing. Thanks.
